messages.subject: [STATSGRASS] GRASS/R interface in ESS
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,

I need some help with programming in GNU R. I try to use
the GRASS/R interface in ESS (Emacs Speaks Statistics)
on Linux.
When I run R command in the ESS, I get the following message:

> library(GRASS)
No GRASS database defined - running in interpreted mode

How do I start up GRASS on Emacs to use R in the ESS?

My environment is
OS: Linux
GNU R: version 1.6.1
GRASS: version grass5.0.0pre4
ESS: version ess-5.1.24

Thanks,
Masaei Sato

messages.subject: [STATSGRASS] Re: GRASS/R interface in ESS
messages.body_plain:
Dear Sato,

assuming you have followed the installation instructions in
http://grass.itc.it/statsgrass/grass_r_interface.html ,

if you start R in an existing GRASS session, you should be enabled to run
the first lines of the tutorial on a R command line.

Then,
exit from R, start emacs from the existing GRASS session, start R in ESS,
run the tutorial commands either in the command *R* window or through the
ESS evaluation mechanisms from a file with .R extensions.

ciao

-- cesare
